exploration.title: GitHub Merge Queue
openQuestions: s11-under-a-queue: does a merge queue end S11 on main (the queue is the only door and the ruleset bypass is reserved for a declared unblocker), or does S11 stay, in which case the queue has no job and the packet is killed?

gate-restatement: replace the 80% main-green bar with properties of the merge-group run itself (parity for all 15 required contexts, p90 wall time, false-ejection rate measured on a lab queue), and supersede the 2026-08-27 standards decision including its strict-first clause?

verdict-placement: is the merge group the delivery of ten-minute-certainty D7's per-SHA main verdict (the same run before the merge instead of after it), replacing that packet's 'Per-SHA main groups' gated candidate rather than adding to it?

first-slice: graduate one small goal now (merge-group parity, a lab-branch queue that settles the 21 undocumented behaviours, the measurement), with activation on main and the Yeet enqueue rework held as gated candidates?
